summary: Phase 6.5 code-splitting refactor verified. All 12 lazy-loaded product/editorial/collection/admin routes render correctly on direct URL deep-link with no ChunkLoadError, no stuck Suspense fallback, and no React duplicate-prop warnings. Cart add-to-cart, cross-route persistence (product -> home -> wishlist -> product), and mock Stripe checkout mount all pass. SearchOverlay finds products and SPA-navigates into lazy chunks without stale SEO. Per-route SEO (title, description, canonical, Product+BreadcrumbList JSON-LD) is unique per product. Morso hero video has exactly one poster attribute (duplicate poster prop fix confirmed) with autoplay/muted/loop/playsInline correct. Metals ticker shows live prices. No frontend regressions attributable to code splitting.

issues: Checkout page inherits previous route document.title (e.g. 'DRAPE | Diamond Statement Pendant | PHILEON') instead of its own 'Checkout' title — CheckoutPage does not set/reset SEO metadata. Minor SEO issue, pre-existing, unrelated to Phase 6.5.

Canonical URL is 'https://phileon.com/quadriga-dominus' (no /products/ prefix) while other products use '/products/<slug>'. Inconsistent canonicals across catalog — pre-existing SEO issue, unrelated to Phase 6.5.

No inline heart/add-to-wishlist toggle on product pages (drape, la-marva). Only the global header wishlist icon exists. Requested wishlist-from-PDP flow cannot be exercised. Not a code-split regression; may be intentional design.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Have CheckoutPage set its own <title>/canonical so lazy nav from a product to /checkout does not leave stale SEO metadata.
(Optional, low priority) Normalize canonical URL of QUADRIGA DOMINUS to include the /products/ prefix like other products.
(Optional) Confirm whether product detail pages are intended to have an inline wishlist toggle; today there is no per-product add-to-wishlist affordance.
critical_code_review_comments: Suspense fallback (data-testid='route-fallback') is a neutral black div; consider a subtle skeleton/spinner so users see progress on slow chunk loads.
CartProvider/WishlistProvider mounted outside Suspense — correct pattern; verified state survives lazy route transitions.
Search overlay results link directly to product hrefs (e.g., /products/bajan-joe) — good, lazy chunks load and SEO updates correctly.
Duplicate `poster` prop on MorsoPage.jsx line 54 is confirmed fixed (single poster attribute on <video>).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 6.5 route code-splitting verified end-to-end via https://labete-gallery.preview.emergentagent.com. Cart drawer testid='cart-drawer' (implicit), open trigger data-testid='cart-button', add-to-cart button data-testid='add-to-cart-button', bajan-joe ring size dropdown uses data-testid='bajan-joe-ringsize-button' with options 'bajan-joe-ringsize-opt-<size>'. SearchOverlay uses data-testid='site-search-trigger'/'site-search-input'/'site-search-results'. Checkout page mounts at /checkout with mock Stripe — do NOT submit real payments. Metals-API console 'Failed to fetch' errors are expected and ignored. Note two pre-existing minor SEO issues to be aware of: (1) /checkout inherits prior page title, (2) QUADRIGA canonical omits /products/ prefix — neither is a Phase 6.5 regression.
